findings.title: Seven-file footprint omits the exact package-export allowlist and its regression fixture

sourceEvidence.fact: assertServerExports requires deep equality with exactly root and development exports.

findings.issue: Adding ./reference-configuration to packages/server/package.json as required makes existing packed smoke fail its unmodified exact-map assertion. The seven-file scope does not permit the helper or its positive regression fixture to change. Updating only the emitted-file inventory and loader checks cannot reach a passing smoke.
findings.impact: Deterministic required smoke/full-suite regression or an unreviewed scope escape/bypass; the proposed installed pure-loader done predicate cannot be met within the declared footprint.
findings.smallestCorrection: Create an explicit plan footprint successor with nine files by adding scripts/smoke-safety.mjs and scripts/smoke-safety.test.mjs. Extend the shared exact export map with only ./reference-configuration -> dist/reference-deployment.d.ts/js, update its positive fixture, and retain rejection of missing, wildcard, candidate/runtime/admission/private exports. Keep smoke-executables calling the shared helper; do not strip the new export before checking, weaken deep equality, or duplicate the allowlist in a second checker.

checks.area: Trusted local input and shared config

Configuration stores only intent/path; no file I/O, auth.token reuse or fixture reinterpretation. Shared resolved Scope/listener/profile/six Read limits remain sole authority.

DEVELOPMENT_OWNER_LIMITS.read supplies actual20/100,4096/32/256,60000 tuple. Preserve existing token uniqueness/principal semantics rather than adding new IAM behavior.

Installed capture returns canonical scope and privateport0; runtime capture compiles/authenticates data and supplies actual seam-free readOptions with2/32,4096/32/256,1000. No owner/listener is opened by these capture functions. Intended shared listener remains separately stored and is not falsely claimed as consumed by current candidate.

No candidate/start/runtime factory is exported by the new data subpath. Current startTransactionRuntime listens before openTransactionStore; plan expressly defers that lifecycle repair and owner-metadata/admission checks to D3c/P rather than claiming them here. Loader success is not evidence eligibility or public activation.

Single ordinary-file handle, bounded32MiB+1 read/fatal UTF8/strict lossless duplicate-name/scalar/number admission, finite envelope bounds, own-data snapshot, fixed-code errors and no secret-bearing parser cause. Existing delegated inner artifact/compiler budgets remain authoritative. Final implementation must actually honor those requirements; no code was executed.

New src module emits four files under existing tsconfig and package dist inclusion. Narrow structural snapshot avoids server->config runtime dependency. Existing smoke exact dist inventory is covered by plan; shared export allowlist/test are the missing two files.
